# apple_alternative_distribution_keys (Data Source)

Lists the account's alternative distribution keys.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_alternative_distribution_keys" "all" {}

data "apple_alternative_distribution_keys" "app_specific" {
  app_specific = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `app_specific` (Boolean) `true` lists only the keys of single apps, `false` only the account's key. Unset lists every key.

### Read-Only

- `keys` (Attributes List) The keys. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--keys))

<a id="nestedatt--keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `keys`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the key.
- `public_key` (String) The public key.
